title: For the Darkspear

texts.details:
Take the letter to Orgrimmar. Gar'Thok will deal with the keep; that is his work. This is for someone else.

Take it to Vol'jin of the Darkspear, who sits beside the Warchief in Grommash Hold. It was his people who were driven from their isles first.

Go by the road north, and look up at the gate when you reach it. Durotar is named for Durotan, the Warchief's father. Orgrimmar is named for Orgrim Doomhammer. We named this land for our dead, $N. The humans on the coast are not the only ones who remember.
texts.objectives: Bring the quartermaster's letter to Vol'jin in Grommash Hold, in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
texts.completion:
Still waitin' on a fleet, eh? Dat be Proudmoore's kind. De man is dead an' dey still be doin' what he said.

De Darkspear remember dose sails, mon. We gonna remember dem a long time. But I tell ya what I tell my people: de daughter is not de father. She showed us de way to him. De ones in dat keep never learned de difference.

Ya did right, bringin' dis here. Take someting from de Darkspear for it.

idea: Chain 3 of 3, and the road to Orgrimmar: what Durotar and Orgrimmar are named for, and Vol'jin's answer.
